name: Twelve published social-science sources with forty-eight constructed controls
purpose: Evaluate source-bound novelty behavior, replication eligibility and uncertainty handling under explicit transformations.
limitations: Constructed controls are not 48 published research ideas or expert novelty judgments.
Four controls from a common source are dependent; report source-cluster and family results.
The source universe is bounded. Global nearest-prior-work recall and intellectual significance remain unmeasured.
No candidate study has been executed. Boundary and mechanism changes remain unresolved.
